record.question: Meena had all her classes in the morning today.
record.explanation: Source/key conflict: 'had' is the main verb followed by the noun phrase 'all her classes', so the printed sentence is simple past (A). Past perfect requires had + a past participle. The Commission's provisional key marks (B), Past perfect. That official entry is retained in the attached key; scoring is withheld rather than silently replacing it. Grammar reference: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/free-resources/grammar/english-grammar-reference/past-perfect
